name: Altitude Cleaning Crew
description: House cleaning in Reno / Sparks, NV: flat-rate pricing, vetted local cleaners, recurring weekly / bi-weekly / monthly visits plus one-time deep cleans from ~$139–$249 (company-stated). 4.9 on Google with 90+ reviews (founder-stated). Founded May 2025, US. Webflow + Stripe. Same MaidsnBlack lane as the Oct 5 standout.

mentions.evidence: MRR $0, ~$18,152 L30 (+0.4%), ~$58,354 last 3 months, ~$231,461 last 12 months, ~$275,237 all-time. Revenue synced Oct 9, 2026 ~04:09 Warsaw (02:09 UTC).
mentions.indieAngle: The software angle, not the brooms: a booking + recurring billing + cleaner-dispatch SaaS for one-city cleaning companies in PL (Warsaw / Kraków / Wrocław), with a "book in 60 seconds" page and SMS day-before confirmations. Charge €79–€149/mo per operator.

whyItPrints: Recurring home services with card-on-file. $0 seat MRR because customers pay per clean; L30 is steady (~$18k) and all-time is already ~$275k in ~16 months. Ads + SEO + TikTok — sweaty, not sexy.
